owner_question: Which channel produced the enquiry and who owns first response?
evidence_to_collect: Redacted source label or campaign name plus owner name
stop_rule: Stop if the source contains patient identifiers or unredacted medical context
proof_boundary: Synthetic template only; no real patient or clinic data

owner_question: Was consent or notice captured before WhatsApp/SMS/email follow-up?
evidence_to_collect: Consent/notice screenshot label or policy reference
stop_rule: Stop if consent status is unclear or needs privacy/legal review

owner_question: What response SLA is promised and who monitors breach risk?
evidence_to_collect: Timestamped SLA queue export with names redacted
stop_rule: Stop if the workflow could send automated medical or pricing claims without human approval
proof_boundary: No outcome ROI booking or medical result claim

owner_question: Where does the enquiry move before booking confirmation?
evidence_to_collect: Owner handoff map from front desk to booking or clinician review
stop_rule: Stop if clinical triage symptoms diagnosis or emergency content appears
proof_boundary: No PHI/ePHI personal data or clinical advice

owner_question: Which growth claims are approved for website ads and follow-up copy?
evidence_to_collect: Approved-copy register with reviewer and source
stop_rule: Stop if a claim promises appointments revenue rankings compliance or AI accuracy
proof_boundary: No testimonial certification ranking demand lead customer revenue or savings claim
